blocks.text: Mechanism woh raasta hai jis par reaction chalta hai, jo dikhata hai ke substrate ke product banne mein kaun se bonds toot'te aur bante hain. Reagent ke lihaz se mechanisms ki do bari qismein hain: free-radical aur ionic (polar). Curly teer electron jore ki harkat dikhate hain, jahan electrons hain wahan se jahan jate hain.

Is mein homolysis se free radicals bante hain jo substrate par hamla karte hain. Misal methane ki chlorination hai halki dhoop mein, jo kul mila kar CH4 + 4Cl2 -> CCl4 + 4HCl tak ja sakti hai. Reaction ke teen marahil hain: initiation, jis mein roshni Cl2 ko do Cl. radicals mein torti hai; propagation, jis mein radicals react kar ke products aur mazeed radicals banate hain (Cl. + CH4 -> HCl + .CH3, phir .CH3 + Cl2 -> CH3Cl + Cl.); aur termination, jis mein do radicals jur jate aur zanjeer ruk jati hai.

items: Nucleophilic substitution: nucleophile saturated, electrophilic carbon par hamla kar ke doosre group, leaving group, ki jagah leta hai, maslan OH- + CH3Br -> CH3OH + Br-, aik transition state ke zariye.

Nucleophilic addition: nucleophile carbonyl compound ke electrophilic carbon par hamla karta, addition product banta hai, maslan CN- ethanal se jurta aur anion HCN se H+ le kar 2-hydroxypropanenitrile banata hai.
Electrophilic addition: electrophile electron se bharpoor jagah, jaise C=C ya C triple bond, par hamla karta hai, maslan HBr ethene se jur kar bromoethane deta hai.
Elimination: parosi carbon atoms se do atoms ya groups hat kar double ya triple bond banate hain, maslan OH- bromoethane se H hatata aur Br- nikalta hai, ethene banti hai.

blocks.alt: H-O- (nucleophile, lone pair ke saath) bromomethane ke carbon par hamla karta hai (aik H dashed bond par, aik wedge par, aik seedhi lakeer par; C +delta, Br -delta); aik mura teer O se C ki taraf aur doosra C-Br bond se Br ki taraf. Is se brackets mein transition state banti hai, charge (-): HO, C aur Br dashed lakeeron se jure, C par teen H. Phir methanol, H-O-C teen H ke saath, aur Br- (leaving group) bante hain.
blocks.caption: Nucleophilic substitution: hydroxide ion aur bromomethane se transition state ke zariye methanol (kitab ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: OH- (nucleophile) apna electron jora C ke us rukh se lata hai jo Br ke ulat hai. Transition state mein O aur Br dono C se aadhe jure hote hain (dashed lakeerein) aur poore ka charge (-) phaila hota hai. Aakhir mein Br apne bond ka jora le kar Br- ki shakal mein nikal jata hai (leaving group) aur methanol banta hai.

blocks.alt: Lone pair wala N teen-bond C- ethanal ke +delta carbon par hamla karta hai (C=O, O par -delta, carbon par H3C aur H); aik mura teer lone pair se C ki taraf aur doosra C=O bond se O ki taraf. Is se N-C-C(H)(CH3) banta hai jis ke O- par lone pairs hain. H-CN (+delta H, -delta CN) ke saath yeh 2-hydroxy propanenitrile, N-C-C(OH)(CH3)-H, aur CN- deta hai.
blocks.caption: Nucleophilic addition: cyanide ion ethanal se jur kar 2-hydroxypropanenitrile banata hai (kitab ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: CN- ka lone pair ethanal ke +delta carbon par jata hai, aur C=O ka pi jora O par chala jata hai; is tarah O- wala anion banta hai. Yeh anion HCN se H+ le leta hai: OH group banta hai aur CN- wapas mil jata hai, jo phir agle molecule par hamla kar sakta hai.

blocks.alt: H2C=CH2 (ethene) aur H-Br, H par +delta aur Br par -delta; aik mura teer C=C double bond se H ki taraf. Is se CH3-CH2-Br (bromoethane) banta hai.
blocks.caption: Electrophilic addition: ethene aur hydrogen bromide se bromoethane (kitab ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab yeh reaction aik qadam mein dikhati hai. Darasal yeh do qadam mein hota hai: pehle C=C ka pi jora H+ (electrophile) ko pakarta hai aur carbocation CH3-CH2+ banta hai, saath Br- alag hota hai; phir Br- carbocation se jur kar bromoethane banata hai.

blocks.alt: Lone pair wala HO- aur bromoethane, CH2-CH2-Br ki shakal mein jis ke pehle carbon ke oopar H hai; Br se jura carbon +delta aur Br -delta. Teen mure teer: HO- ke lone pair se H ki taraf, C-H bond se C-C bond ki taraf, aur C-Br bond se Br ki taraf. Products: CH2=CH2 (ethene) + H2O + Br-.
blocks.caption: Elimination: hydroxide ion aur bromoethane se ethene, paani aur bromide ion (kitab ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka; kitab ki ghalati durust).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Teen teer aik saath chalte hain: HO- aik carbon ka H kheench leta hai (paani banta hai), C-H bond ka jora do carbon ke darmiyan doosra bond banata hai, aur Br apna jora le kar Br- ban jata hai. Kitab Br wale CH2 par '-delta' chhaapti hai; Br carbon se zyada electronegative hai, is liye us carbon par +delta hota hai, aur khaake mein +delta likha hai.

blocks.prompt: NH3, Br. (bromine atom), H2O, NO2+ aur Cl(delta+) ko electrophile, nucleophile ya free radical batayein.
blocks.explanation: NH3: nucleophile; Br.: free radical; H2O: nucleophile; NO2+: electrophile; Cl(delta+): electrophile.

blocks.prompt: Taqseem karein: (i) CH3CH=CH2 + HBr -> CH3CHBrCH3; (ii) CH4 + Br2 -> CH3Br + HBr; (iii) CH3CH2CHClCH3 -> CH3CH2CH=CH2 + HCl.
Taqseem karein: (i) (CH3)2C=O + H2N-NH2 -> (CH3)2C=N-NH2 + H2O; (ii) CH3CHO + 2[H] -> CH3CH2OH.
blocks.explanation: (i) condensation (do molecules paani nikal kar jurte); (ii) reduction (hydrogen ka izafa), jo addition bhi hai.

items: Free-radical: initiation, propagation, termination (maslan methane ki chlorination).
Ionic: nucleophilic substitution, nucleophilic addition, electrophilic addition, elimination.
Curly teer electron joron ki harkat dikhate.
